# BridgeX Studio

> BridgeX Studio helps people plan and build websites, brand identities, campaigns and ongoing digital support. Every project starts with a conversation rather than a fixed package, and quotes are prepared case by case.

## Services

- [Websites](https://studio.bridgex.sg/#services): A clear, credible home for your business, idea or community.
- [Brand & design](https://studio.bridgex.sg/#services): A visual identity that helps people recognise and remember you.
- [Campaigns](https://studio.bridgex.sg/#services): Focused creative support for launches, events and growth.
- [Ongoing support](https://studio.bridgex.sg/#services): A reliable partner to improve, update and keep things moving.

## Start a project

- [Shape your brief](https://studio.bridgex.sg/#start): Choose one or more services to start a brief. BridgeX Studio reviews your needs before preparing a quote.
